name: SM_Dungeon_Pillar_Twin_PR
dresses: twin stone columns on a two-step plinth, 1.04 x 0.6 x 2.4 m: each of four drums a little out of true, moulded base and capital, square abacus; a spall lying by the plinth

fit.pivot: base centre; the pair stands along X
fit.moss: painted damp and dirty with a trace of algae at the foot only

material_exception: shared tiling scan sets with a vertex-colour weathering layer (MI_Prop_* / MI_Struct_*), not private bakes and not yet rows of ART_STANDARD.md section 2. Edge wear, stains and soot are per-vertex. A unique bake per prop is the next step where the weaknesses say so.
known_weaknesses: One review round. Drums are lathes of the FieldBoulder scan: joints are thin gaps without mortar or chipping, mouldings are simple; the scan wraps round each drum with a seam.
